description: This file defines a wizard for tracking production moves in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including UI forms and logic for splitting production lots.

classes.name: wizard_track_move
classes.description: A wizard interface class for tracking and splitting production moves.

methods.name: _get_moves
methods.description: Generates a form with move tracking options based on production state.

methods.name: _track_lines
methods.description: Creates production lots and updates stock moves with tracking info.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Determines the next state of the wizard based on production completion status.
